---
params:
  project_id: "2026-06-LLH"
  folder: "projects/2026-06-projects"
output: rmdformats::robobook
title: "Team `r toupper(params$project_id)`"
---


```{r, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE)
library(googlesheets4)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(correltools)
library(forcats)
library(readr)
source(here::here("templates", "viz.R"))
source(here::here("R", "transform.R"))

theme_set(correltools::theme_correlaid())
rating_mapping <- load_rating_mapping()
team <- readr::read_csv(here::here(params$folder, "data", "selected.csv")) %>% 
  filter(project_id == params$project_id)
```
```{r}
mapping <- readr::read_csv(here::here(params$folder, "data/mapping.csv"))
wide <- readr::read_csv(here::here(params$folder, "data/applicant_wide.csv"))

skill_ratings <- readr::read_csv(here::here(params$folder, "data/applicant_skill_ratings.csv"))
role_profiles <- readr::read_csv(here::here(params$folder, "data/role_profiles_long.csv")) %>% 
  filter(project_id == params$project_id)

skill_ratings_sel <- skill_ratings %>% 
  left_join(team) %>% 
  filter(applicant_id %in% team$applicant_id) %>% 
  filter(skill %in% role_profiles$skill)
```

# Overview

## German skills

```{r}
team <- team %>% left_join(wide %>% select(applicant_id, german_skills))
knitr::kable(team %>% select(first_name, role, german_skills))
```


## Technical skills

```{r}
# plot to see how people contribute to the skills
# how many people per role
roles_distribution <- team %>% count(role, name = "n_role")

skill_ratings_sel %>% 
  arrange(question, skill) %>% 
  left_join(roles_distribution, by = "role") %>% 
  mutate(pos = 1:n()) %>% 
  group_by(role, skill, pos, first_name) %>%
  summarize(collective_skill_rating = sum(rating_num) / (4 * n_role)) %>%     
ggplot(aes(y = fct_reorder(skill, -pos), fill = as.factor(first_name), group = role, x = collective_skill_rating)) +
    geom_col(position = "stack")+
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), labels = scales::percent_format())+
    scale_fill_correlaid_d()+
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(), 
      legend.position = "bottom"
    ) +
    labs(y = NULL, color = "", fill = "", x = "% achieved of max skill")+
  facet_wrap(~role)

```


# People

```{r results='asis'}

# only applications for this role
appl_sorted <- team %>% 
  arrange(role)
purrr::walk(appl_sorted$applicant_id, function(applicant_id) {
  
  
  
  a <- appl_sorted %>% filter(applicant_id == .env$applicant_id)

  # get self ratings of applicant for role to plot
  a_ratings_role <- skill_ratings_sel %>% 
    filter(applicant_id == .env$applicant_id) %>% 
    get_relevant_skill_ratings_for_project_role(role_profiles, params$project_id, a$role)

  # header
  cat(sprintf("# %s %s - %s", a$first_name, a$last_name, a$role), sep = "\n")

  # knit intro 
  params <- list(applicant_id = applicant_id, folder = params$folder, file_scored_applicants = here::here(params$folder, "data/scored_applicants.csv"), file_applicant_wide = here::here(params$folder, "data/applicant_wide.csv"))

  intro <- knitr::knit_child(
    here::here("templates", 'applicant_intro.Rmd'), envir = environment(), quiet = TRUE
  )
  cat(intro, sep = "\n")
  
  # plot
  p <- skill_plot(a_ratings_role, rating_mapping, "priority")
  print(p)
  
  cat("**All skills**", sep = "\n")
  p <- skill_plot(skill_ratings %>% filter(applicant_id == a$applicant_id), rating_mapping)
  print(p)
  cat("\n", sep = "\n")
  
})
```
